profile.headline: Senior SDET | AI/LLM Developer Tooling | QA Automation | DevOps
profile.summary:
I'm a senior software engineer specializing in automation, developer tooling, AI-assisted development, and quality engineering.

Throughout my career, I've often been the person brought in when a team needs to move beyond manual testing, build an automation strategy, or turn a recurring engineering problem into a reusable tool. I've built automation frameworks and infrastructure for web, API, backend, and mobile applications, integrated them into CI/CD pipelines, and helped teams establish practices that make reliable, frequent releases possible.

More recently, I've focused on AI-assisted software development and developer tooling. I created and architected Contextus, a local-first context and retrieval system for Claude Code that uses lifecycle hooks, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, adaptive context injection, evaluation, and calibration to provide coding agents with relevant project knowledge at the right time.
I also created Vector Inspector (github.com/anthonypdawson/vector-inspector), an open-source cross-platform desktop application for inspecting, querying, and visualizing vector databases across Chroma, Qdrant, Pinecone, LanceDB, pgvector, Weaviate, and Milvus. The project is published on PyPI, includes installers for macOS, Linux, and Windows, and has shipped through more than 40 releases.

Building these systems has deepened my interest in the engineering challenges surrounding AI agents: context retrieval, tool design, evaluation, reliability, and measuring whether these systems are actually helping developers work more effectively.

I'm a software polyglot with extensive experience in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, and Ruby. I've never been particularly attached to a specific language or framework. I'm more interested in understanding the problem and choosing the right tool for the job.

What I enjoy most is taking something that is difficult, repetitive, unreliable, or poorly defined and building a system that makes it easier for other engineers to do their jobs.

I'm equally comfortable contributing to product development, building internal platforms, or improving CI/CD and release processes. I enjoy working on problems that cross traditional boundaries between software engineering, quality engineering, infrastructure, and developer productivity.

I've worked remotely for most of my career, both embedded within larger organizations and as part of fully distributed teams. Wherever the team is located, I value thoughtful engineering, autonomy, collaboration, and solving interesting problems together.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer in Test
positions.description:
SDET specializing in end-to-end testing for React Native healthcare applications. Design and maintain robust test automation frameworks using WebDriverIO, Appium, and TypeScript, supporting both iOS and Android platforms.

• Build scalable Page Object Model architectures for complex mobile workflows
• Debug and resolve framework-level challenges (e.g., handling virtualized UI components, platform-specific behaviors)
• Execute automated and manual testing across local iOS/Android devices and BrowserStack cloud infrastructure
• Perform manual exploratory testing for new features and conduct biweekly regression testing for release validation
• Collaborate with development teams on test infrastructure and testID standards
• Leverage modern AI development tools to accelerate test creation and maintenance while ensuring quality

Balance automated testing with hands-on manual testing to ensure comprehensive coverage and catch edge cases that automation might miss. Focus on reliable automation that catches real issues while minimizing flaky tests.
